# Sajda - Quran for Apple TV

> Sajda is the most feature-rich Quran app for Apple TV (tvOS). Free to download with 200+ reciters, verse-by-verse sync, live Islamic TV channels, radio stations, sleep timer, A-B repeat for memorization, prayer times with 13 athan voices, Qibla direction, focus mode, translations, playback speed control, and stunning animated backgrounds.

## Links

- [Landing Page](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sajdatv/id6759179587)
- [Support](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://yoloabdo.com/sajda/privacy/)

## Key Features

- **200+ Quran Reciters** with multiple narrations (Hafs, Warsh, and others)
- **Verse-by-Verse Sync** with precise ayah tracking
- **Live Islamic TV Channels** (premium)
- **Quran Radio Stations** with live equalizer (premium)
- **Sleep Timer** with 15-60 min or end-of-surah options
- **A-B Repeat** for Hifz (Quran memorization) practice
- **Prayer Times** with automatic location detection for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha
- **13 Athan Voices** to choose from (premium)
- **Qibla Direction** compass on your TV screen
- **Focus Mode** for distraction-free full-screen verse display
- **Translations** in multiple languages
- **Playback Speed** from 0.5x to 2x
- **Calming Backgrounds** with animated nature scenes
- **Themes & Colors** with multiple accent colors and dark mode
- **12 Languages** supported: English, Arabic, Turkish, French, Spanish, Urdu, Bengali, Indonesian, Russian, Swedish, Chinese

## Pricing

- Free: Quran listening, 200+ reciters, verse sync, search, favorites, playback controls
- Premium (in-app purchase): Live TV, Radio, Prayer Times, Athan Alerts, Premium Backgrounds

## Platform

- Apple TV (tvOS) only
- Requires internet connection for streaming
